clue.text: Considered getting married after struggle

indicators.note: after puts the marriage word behind the struggle word

parts.note: to vie is to struggle or compete
to wed is to get married

explanation.surface: Someone thought things over and married following a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something viewed in a certain way has been regarded or considered so.

clue.text: Military order logs to be placed here

definitions.meaning: the command given to soldiers to start shooting
an uncovered hearth fire is where logs are put to burn

explanation.surface: A command from the army about where to stack firewood.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both the command to start shooting and an open hearth that takes logs.

clue.text: Source of solvent messing up internet

indicators.note: messing up the words jumbles their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's chemical supplier is messing up the internet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'messing' is the anagram signal; 'up internet' is the fodder, so 'up' is not part of the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: The oil distilled from pine resin is used as a paint thinner, a classic solvent.

clue.text: Royal jester — one of three in a suit

definitions.text: one of three in a suit

parts.note: the court is the royal household
a card is a joker or comic person

explanation.surface: A king's fool is among three people dressed alike.
explanation.walkthrough: Each suit of playing cards holds three picture cards: jack, queen and king.
explanation.definitionFit: The jack, queen and king are the three picture cards in each suit of a pack.

clue.text: Boundary crossed by landed gentry

indicators.note: the boundary lies across the joined words, its letters spanning both

explanation.surface: A property line runs through the estate of country squires.
explanation.definitionFit: An edge is the border or limit of an area, a synonym for boundary.

clue.text: Country code accepted in most of letters

indicators.note: accepted in means taken inside the trimmed word
most of the word means its final letter is dropped

parts.note: letters arriving by post are mail
a law is a code or rule

explanation.surface: A national dialling code appears in most correspondence.
explanation.definitionFit: Malawi is a landlocked nation in south-east Africa.

clue.text: Those in attendance are alert

definitions.meaning: everyone who is present, the whole company here

explanation.surface: Everyone present is wide awake.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both everyone present and, idiomatically, having one's wits about one.

clue.text: Appropriate way in which Ezra introduced himself?

definitions.meaning: used as a verb: to seize or confiscate

definitions.text: way in which Ezra introduced himself?
definitions.meaning: the poet Ezra Pound might say 'I am Pound' on meeting someone

explanation.surface: A suitable greeting the poet might have used.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' reads as an adjective but is the verb meaning to take possession of.
explanation.definitionFit: To impound goods is to seize them legally, to appropriate them.

clue.text: Oxbridge academic accepts women drink

indicators.note: accepts means the academic takes the letter inside

parts.note: a don is a university teacher, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A university lecturer lets female students have a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To down a drink is to swallow it quickly, used as a verb.

clue.text: Not even degree students can be eccentric

parts.note: odd numbers are those that are not even
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree
L is a learner, so two learners are LL

explanation.surface: Uneven-performing graduates can be a bit strange.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddball is a strange or unconventional person, so an eccentric one.

clue.text: Dollars initially invested in victory might provide a source of energy

parts.note: a win is a victory

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: might as a noun means strength or power

explanation.surface: Money put into a winning venture could produce energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might' looks like a verb but is the noun meaning strength.
explanation.definitionFit: Electricity generated by turbines driven by moving air is a renewable energy source.

clue.text: Praise army officer after cut back

indicators.note: after puts the officer behind the turned word
back means the cut word is read from right to left

parts.note: to axe something is to cut it
LT is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: Applauding a soldier of rank after his pay was reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: To exalt someone is to praise or glorify them highly.

clue.text: Condescend to listen to European

indicators.note: to listen to means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a Dane is a European from Denmark

explanation.surface: A snobbish person stoops to hear out someone from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: To deign is to lower oneself to do something, the same as condescend.

clue.text: Plan no deceit — no time for such a remedy

indicators.note: to plan is to arrange or lay out, so the letters are rearranged
the second no says the time letter is removed

explanation.surface: A doctor promises honest advice with no delay about treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: Take NODECEIT, drop the T signalled by 'no time', and rearrange NODECEI as signalled by 'Plan'.
explanation.definitionFit: Codeine is an opiate painkiller, a kind of medicinal remedy.

clue.text: Astounded by stupid son on lorry

parts.note: dumb is slang for stupid
a lorry is the British word for a truck

explanation.surface: Shocked at seeing a foolish boy riding on a heavy goods vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumbstruck means so amazed as to be speechless, the same as astounded.

clue.text: One doesn't know if it's amusing or outrageous

indicators.note: outrageous suggests wild disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A person who doesn't get the joke wonders if it is funny or offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: An ignoramus is an ignorant person, one lacking knowledge.

clue.text: Plant genre improves in process

indicators.note: to process material is to work it into a new form, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A style of writing gets better as it is developed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is part of the fodder, not a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a flowering plant with yellow blooms that open in the evening.

clue.text: Admission to hospital department managed before church

indicators.note: before puts the earlier pieces ahead of the church letters

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
ran means managed
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A patient is admitted to a ward that was run near a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrance means the right or act of entering, that is, admission.

clue.text: Exposed route is rumoured to be of more importance

parts.note: out means revealed or exposed

indicators.note: is rumoured signals that the word is passed on by speech

parts.note: a way is a route

explanation.surface: A public path is said to matter more.
explanation.definitionFit: To outweigh something is to be greater in significance than it.

clue.text: Treat skin with mousse, love and fruit

parts.note: to tan is to treat hide or skin
a gel is a hair product like mousse
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: Beauty routine of a tanning lotion, styling product and something sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangelo is a citrus fruit crossing a tangerine with a pomelo or grapefruit.

clue.text: Drink in sort of trance

indicators.note: sort of hints at a loose version, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something to drink while in a hypnotic state.
explanation.definitionFit: Nectar is the drink of the gods, and also any sweet fruit drink.

clue.text: Start working and fight

explanation.surface: Getting down to business and brawling.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means to begin vigorously; as a noun, a scrap or quarrel.

clue.text: Pleasure trip that's revealing

definitions.meaning: exposing someone, especially as gay, without consent

explanation.surface: A jaunt that exposes something.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an excursion and the act of exposing a person's secret.

clue.text: Regularly buys lead secondhand

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A shopper often buys old pencil refills.
explanation.definitionFit: Used goods have had a previous owner, so are secondhand.

clue.text: A way to take in company's course

indicators.note: to take in means the way letters enclose the company letters

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
CO is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A firm's route to a race meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: ASCOT is a racecourse in Berkshire, England, home of Royal Ascot.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascot is a famous racecourse, so a course in the horse-racing sense.

clue.text: Bound to be exhausted, disheartened

indicators.note: disheartened means losing the heart, the middle letter

parts.note: tired means exhausted

explanation.surface: Someone is sure to be worn out and dispirited.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied means bound, as with rope.

clue.text: Sailor despatched around world is like a sponge

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: around means the despatched word wraps the world word

parts.note: sent means despatched
an orb is a globe or world

explanation.surface: A seaman sent round the globe soaks everything up.
explanation.definitionFit: A sponge soaks up liquid, so something absorbent is spongelike.

clue.text: A chute and a bouncy castle

indicators.note: bouncy suggests jumping about, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Children's party equipment: a slide and an inflatable castle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bouncy castle' looks like a phrase, but 'bouncy' is the anagram signal and 'castle' the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A chateau is a French castle or large country house.

clue.text: Endless pain following month in shape

indicators.note: following puts the pain word after the month

parts.note: DEC is the abbreviation for December

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: agony is great pain

explanation.surface: A suffering that stretches beyond a calendar month takes form.
explanation.definitionFit: A decagon is a ten-sided polygon, a geometric shape.
